svg.title: Full-stack development on a 2004 flip phone
svg.desc: Anime-style illustration of a man with a ponytail and goatee on a high-rise balcony, holding up a 2004 flip phone and looking confused as he tries to build a full-stack web app on it. The phone screen cycles through npm install over GPRS, a memory-full warning, a Docker error, and an incoming call from Mom.
